name: Dorei Ouhi Sophia
source:
The assault of Queen Sophia. 
She made use of that flesh to deceive Premequia, 
but what happened after? The answer is revealed. 

A visual novel with voice acting, CG gallery, 
and other features that have been included in past 

Part of the original fantasy series "the Legend of the Deep" 

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE147284.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
索菲娅女王遭到袭击。
她利用那具肉体欺骗了普雷梅基亚，但之后究竟发生了什么？答案即将揭晓。

本作是一部带有配音、CG画廊以及历代作品中其他功能的视觉小说。

作品属于原创奇幻系列《深海传说》。

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE147284.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
